name: trees
cmd: R=$(cd $S/../../.. && pwd); cd $R && git fetch -q origin laya-decision-best laya-decision-perf-rebased && for t in 't_pr 84db80f0a' 't_dh 12fcce54c' 't_ours origin/laya-decision-perf-rebased' 't_best origin/laya-decision-best' 't_bestns origin/laya-decision-best~1'; do set -- $t; [ -d $ROOT/$1 ] || git worktree add -q --detach $ROOT/$1 $2; echo "LAYA_TREE $1 $(git -C $ROOT/$1 log -1 --format='%h %s')"; done

name: pytest_t_pr
cmd: cd $ROOT/t_pr && $PY -m pytest tests/test_decision_model.py -q -rfE --tb=short -p no:cacheprovider 2>&1 | grep -vE 'Warning|warnings.warn|^  ' | tail -120

name: pytest_t_dh
cmd: cd $ROOT/t_dh && $PY -m pytest tests/test_decision_model.py -q -rfE --tb=short -p no:cacheprovider 2>&1 | grep -vE 'Warning|warnings.warn|^  ' | tail -120

name: pytest_t_best
cmd: cd $ROOT/t_best && $PY -m pytest tests/test_decision_model.py -q -rfE --tb=short -p no:cacheprovider 2>&1 | grep -vE 'Warning|warnings.warn|^  ' | tail -120

name: pytest_best_lean_alone
cmd: cd $ROOT/t_best && $PY -m pytest tests/test_decision_model.py -q -k 'lean_lora or cudnn or compiled_layers_use_plain' --tb=short -p no:cacheprovider 2>&1 | tail -30
